fusions.name: Boulder Let Go
fusions.desc: Sets a boulder rolling at a target up to 8 tiles away. It deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Shingle Spray
fusions.desc: Throws up 4 stones at once, spread apart, and each deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathers No Moss
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 18% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Beaten Path
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
